title: Shenzhen University's Libraries: 40 Years of Innovation & Legacy
description: As Shenzhen's sole comprehensive university, SZU is a pioneer in China's higher education reform. Join Xiao Zhang to explore its libraries, including historic Huilin Building (1986), housing 5 million documents. Witness modernization efforts—automation, student-friendly upgrades, and its role as a vibrant academic hub in the Greater Bay Area.
